description: This file provides an interface for integrating with the GNews API, including functions to fetch top headlines, search articles, and normalize data.

methods.name: buildQuery(params = {})
methods.description: Builds URL query string with parameters and API key.

methods.name: doFetch(path, params = {})
methods.description: Performs the fetch request to the news API with error handling.

methods.name: normalizeArticle(a)
methods.description: Normalizes a GNews article object to the app-specific shape.

methods.name: fetchTopHeadlines({ category, page = 1, pageSize = 20, language = 'en' } = {})
methods.description: Fetches top headlines from GNews API with optional category, pagination, and language.

methods.name: searchEverything({ q, language = 'en', page = 1, pageSize = 20 } = {})
methods.description: Performs a keyword search across news sources with pagination.

methods.name: fetchCategory(category, { page = 1, pageSize = 20, language = 'en' } = {})
methods.description: Convenience wrapper to fetch headlines for a specific category.
